summary: Assault Mode cards and the Synchro Monsters they upgrade, with generic staples; the page's Psychic and Resonator routes are left out. Every Assault Mode monster needs its base Synchro, so those Synchros are in the Extra Deck as allowed cards. The 2026 wave leads. Duel Evolution - Assault Zone searches any monster that mentions Assault Mode Activate and, for 2000 LP, lets Assault Mode Activate tribute a Synchro straight from the Extra Deck, which turns Red Nova Dragon, Junk Warrior and T.G. Halberd Cannon into live targets without summoning them. Nightwinged Cleric, a generic Level 8 Synchro, sets Assault Mode Activate so it can be used that turn. Crimson Blader/Assault Mode searches from the hand. Red Nova Dragon/Assault Mode banishes their cards for each Tuner in your GY. Psi-Reflector plus Assault Beast makes the Level 8 Synchro on its own. Black Rose Dragon/Assault Mode is not out in the TCG yet.

exclude.Black Rose Dragon/Assault Mode: Not yet released in the TCG.

main: Psi-Reflector
Tuner starter: searches Assault Mode Activate or a card that lists it; revives Assault Beast with a higher Level.
Assault Beast
Discards itself to search Assault Mode Activate, then comes back with Psi-Reflector for a Level 8 Synchro.
Arcane Apprentice
Tuner: searches Assault Mode Activate when used for a Synchro Summon.
Red Nova Dragon/Assault Mode
Newest card: banishes their cards for each Tuner in your GY, and stops an attack.
Crimson Blader/Assault Mode
Reveals from the hand to search Assault Mode Activate or a card that mentions it; shuts off Level 5+ Extra Deck monsters.
Junk Warrior/Assault Mode
Unaffected by their monster effects; grows with each Assault Mode monster.
Stardust Dragon/Assault Mode
Tributes itself to negate any activation, then returns in the End Phase.
Red Dragon Archfiend/Assault Mode
Destroys every other monster when it attacks.
T.G. Halberd Cannon/Assault Mode
Negates a Summon and banishes their Special Summoned monsters.
Duel Evolution - Assault Zone
Field Spell: searches an Assault Mode monster and lets Assault Mode Activate tribute from the Extra Deck.
Assault Mode Zero
Quick-Play version of Assault Mode Activate, from the hand.
Assault Teleport
Shuffles a stuck Assault Mode monster back to draw 2.
Assault Mode Activate
Tributes a Synchro to summon its Assault Mode form from the Deck.
Assault Reboot
Swaps one Assault Mode monster for another from the Deck.
Assault Counter
Counter Trap: negates any activation while you control an Assault Mode monster.
